request.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into an ice-age war longship: the hull becomes dark brown-grey hide over wood, colour #493736 with #2d2b2b shadows, with round ice-blue ice shields; the grey castles become hide tents; an ice-blue crystal figurehead; the red sails become sails of shaggy warm white fur, colour #e3d5b7 shaded warm taupe #8c7667, never blue-grey. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
